summary: FD_TC_218_3rd Party � Claims Company � Claim Opened � Exists in CS � Case < 30 Days � No Resolution � User Disputes � Manual Handoff
title: 3rd Party � Claims Company � Claim Opened � Exists in CS � Case < 30 Days � No Resolution � User Disputes � Manual Handoff
description:
Validates that when a claims company is told to wait but disputes, the system escalates to manual handoff.

Prerequisites:
Third-party caller type: Claims Company. Passenger has opened a claim. Case number exists in CS. Case opened 20 days ago. No resolution. User disputes the wait message.
